Lapho ubuyela ekhaya ngemva kokuhlala phesheya, uye wajwayela isiko elisha futhi walahlekelwa ezinye zezimiso zakho zamasiko asekhaya.
Lapho uqala ukuya phesheya, abantu cishe babekezela futhi beqondana, bazi ukuthi abahambi ezweni elisha kudingeka bazivumelanise.
Abantu bangase bangalindele ukuthi ukubekezela nokuqonda kuyadingeka futhi kubavakashi ababuyela ekhaya.
Umbukiso wezwi nokukhanya kwe-pyramid ungenye yezinto ezithakazelisa kakhulu kule ndawo ezinganeni.
Ungabona amaphiramidi ebumnyameni futhi ungawabona ethule ngaphambi kokuba kuqale umbukiso.
Ngokuvamile uhlala lapha umsindo wabavakashi nabathengisi. Indaba yomsindo nokukhanya ifana nencwadi yezindaba.
I-Sphinx isethwe njengesimo sangemuva nomxoxi wezindaba ezinde.
Izithombe ziboniswa emapiramidini futhi amapiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.
Iziqhingi zaseSouth Shetland, ezatholakala ngo-1819, zibizwa izizwe eziningana futhi zinamasisekelo amaningi, ezineshumi nesithupha ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.
Iziqhingi zisezingeni elingamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Esikhulu kunazo zonke yiKing George Island enendawo yokuhlala yaseVilla Las Estrellas.
Ezinye zihlanganisa iLivingston Island, neDeception lapho i-caldera egcwala amanzi yentaba-mlilo esasebenza inikeza khona itheku lemvelo elimangalisayo.
I-Ellsworth Land iyisifunda esiseningizimu yeNhlonhlo, esilinganiswe uLwandle lwaseBellingshausen.
Izintaba zePeninsula lapha zihlanganiswa endaweni enesiqongo, bese ziphinde zivela ukuze zakhe uchungechunge lwamakhilomitha angu-360 lwezintaba zase-Ellsworth, oluhlukaniswe yi-Minnesota Glacier.
Ingxenye esenyakatho noma i-Sentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kakhulu e-Antarctica, i-Vinson Massif, ephakeme ngamamitha angu-4892 i-Mount Vinson.
Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kokufakwa komakhalekhukhwini, kungenzeka ukuthi ucingo lwesathelayithi luyindlela yakho kuphela.
Ucingo lwe-satellite ngokuvamile aluyona into ezongena esikhundleni se-mobile, njengoba kufanele ube ngaphandle unombono ocacile we-satellite ukuze wenze ucingo.
Le nkonzo ivame ukusetshenziswa yizimpahla, kufaka phakathi izikebhe zokuzijabulisa, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwabantu abanezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.
Umhlinzeki wakho wocingo lwasendaweni kufanele akwazi ukunikeza ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulesi sikhungo.
Inketho ethandwa kakhulu kulabo abahlela unyaka we-gap-year ukuhamba nokufunda.
Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu yilabo abaphuma esikoleni, kubavumela ukuba bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kokuba baqale eyunivesithi, ngaphandle kokuphazamisana nemfundo yabo.
Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa izifundo zonyaka we-gap-year phesheya kwezilwandle empeleni kungathuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme ezweni lakini.
Ngokuvamile kuzoba nemali yokufunda ukuze ubhalise kulezi zinhlelo zemfundo.
IFinland iyindawo enkulu yokushushumbisa ngesikebhe. "Izwe lamachibi ayinkulungwane" linezinkulungwane zeziqhingi, emachibi naseziqhingini ezisogwini.
Ezithunzini namachibi awudingi ngempela isikebhe.
Nakuba iziqhingi ezisogwini namachibi amakhulu ngempela mancane ngokwanele ukuba angahlala kuyo noma yiliphi i-yacht, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak zinikeza okuhlangenwe nakho okuhlukile.
Ukuhamba ngesikebhe kuyindlela yokuzilibazisa kazwelonke eFinland, lapho isikebhe sifinyelela khona abantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.
Lokhu kufaniswa neNorway, iSweden neNew Zealand, kodwa ngenye indlela okuyingqayizivele (isib. eNetherlands isibalo singu-1 kuya kwamashumi amane).
Iningi le-Baltic Cruises ehlukile lihlala isikhathi eside eSt. Petersburg, eRussia.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elinomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ngokugcwele ngenkathi ubuya futhi ulale emkhunjini ebusuku.
Uma uya ogwini usebenzisa kuphela uhambo ngomkhumbi ngeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).

Ezinye izinkambo ze-cruise zine-Berlin, eJalimane ezincwadini. Njengoba ubona kumephu engenhla kweBerlin ayikho indawo eseduze nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe entengweni ye-cruise.
Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba yinto esabekayo kubantu babo bonke ubudala kanye nemvelaphi, ikakhulukazi uma bengakaze bahambe indiza ngaphambili noma beye babhekana nesenzakalo esibuhlungu.
Akukhona into okumele ube namahloni ngayo: akuhlukile ekusabeni nokungayithandiyo abanye abantu abaningi.
Kwabanye, ukuqonda okuthile ngendlela izindiza ezisebenza ngayo nokuthi kwenzekani ngesikhathi endizeni kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukwesaba okusekelwe kokungaziwa noma ekutheni awukwazi ukulawula.

Izinkampani zezithuthi zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuletha izinto ngokushesha. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibaluleke kakhulu ngemibhalo yebhizinisi, izimpahla noma izingxenye ezisele ukuze kulungiswe ngokushesha.
Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkulu zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane kwakunenkinga.
Uma bathumela izinto ngomkhumbi, kwezinye izindlela kungase kuthathe izinsuku ukudiliza nokulayisha kanye nokuthumela izimpahla.
Indlela kuphela yokuyiyisa ngokushesha kwakuwukuthumela njengempahla ebhalisiwe. Imithetho yezindiza ayiyi kuvumela ukuba ithumele impahla ngaphandle komgibeli, okulapho ungena khona.
Indlela esobala yokundiza esigabeni sokuqala noma sebhizinisi ukuphaza imali eningi ukuze uthole ilungelo (noma, okungcono nakakhulu, yenza inkampani yakho ikwenzele lona).
Kodwa-ke, lokhu akubizi: njengemithetho elukhuni, ungalindela ukukhokha imali efinyelela kokune kunemali evamile yebhizinisi, futhi izikhathi eziyishumi nanye yeklasi lokuqala!
Ngokuvamile, akukho njongo ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo zezihlalo zebhizinisi noma zeklasi lokuqala ezindizeni eziqondile ezivela ku-A kuya ku-B.
Izindiza zamazwe azi kahle ukuthi kunamaqembu athile abagibeli abazimisele ukukhokha imali ephezulu ngenzuzo yokufinyelela endaweni esheshayo nekhululekile, futhi bakhokhe ngokufanele.
Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChişinău. Ulimi lwendawo luyiRomanian, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kakhulu.

Ngo-1994, le ngxabano yaholela ekwakhiweni kweRiphabhuliki yeTransnistria ezimenyezelwe empumalanga yeMoldova, enohulumeni wayo nemali yayo kodwa engaziwa yiliphi izwe elingamalungu e-UN.
Izixhumanisi zezomnotho ziye zabuyiselwa phakathi kwalezi zingxenye ezimbili zaseMoldova naphezu kokwehluleka kwezingxoxo zezombusazwe.
Inkolo enkulu eMoldova ubuKristu obu-Orthodox.
I-Izmir yidolobha lesithathu ngobukhulu eTurkey elinabantu abangaba yizigidi ezingu-3.7, itheku lesibili ngobukhulu ngemva kwe-Istanbul, kanye nendawo enhle kakhulu yezokuthutha.

Esangweni, kunemifanekiso ethungathiwe yamamarufa ethinta inhliziyo yamajuba ngaphezu kwamathuna athile.
Kuwufanele isigamu sehora ukuhambahamba kulowo muzi othakazelisayo.
Enyakatho futhi ekufinyeleleni kalula idolobha elithandekayo nelikhangayo laseSintra futhi elaziwa ngabangaphandle ngemva kokuba lichaze kahle ubuhle balo obalotshwa nguLord Byron.
Ibhasi i-Scotturb 403 ihamba njalo iya eSintra, imisa eCabo da Roca.
Futhi enyakatho vakashela iNdlu Engcwele enkulu yeNkosikazi Yethu yaseFatima (Shrine), indawo yokubonakala kukaMariya edumile emhlabeni wonke.
Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi ngokuyisisekelo uvakashela indawo yamathuna omphakathi, kanye nendawo enencazelo engenakulinganiswa engxenyeni ebalulekile yabantu bomhlaba.
Kusenabantu abaningi abesilisa nabesifazane abaphilayo abasinda esikhathini sabo lapha, futhi abaningi ababenabathandekayo ababulawa noma abasebenza khona, amaJuda kanye nabangewona amaJuda.
Sicela uphathe isayithi ngesithunzi, isithunzi nenhlonipho elifanele. Ungenzi amahlaya nge-Holocaust noma ngamaNazi.
Ungonakalisi indawo ngokubeka uphawu noma ngokukhasa imidwebo ezakhiweni.
Izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseBarcelona ziyiCatalan neSpanishi. Cishe ingxenye ithanda ukukhuluma isiCatalan, iningi liyasiqonda, futhi cishe wonke umuntu uyazi iSpanishi.
Kodwa-ke, izimpawu eziningi zibhalwe ngesiCatalan kuphela ngoba umthetho usimisile njengolimi lokuqala olusemthethweni.

Ipaki kazwelonke yamachibi asePlitvice inezihlahla eziningi, ikakhulukazi izihlahla ze-beach, i-spruce, ne-fir, futhi inezinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo zase-Alpine neMedithera.
Inemiphakathi yezitshalo ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngenxa yobubanzi bayo bezimo zezulu ezincane, inhlabathi ehlukene namazinga aphakeme ahlukahlukene.
Le ndawo iphinde ibe nekhaya lezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezinyoni.
Izilwane ezingavamile ezifana ne-European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, cat yasendle kanye ne-capercaillie zingatholakala lapho, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ezivamile
Lapho bevakashela izindlu zamasonto, abesifazane kudingeka bagqoke iziketi ezihlanganisa amadolo futhi bavale namahlombe abo.

Izindlu eziningi zendlu yesigodlo zinikeza izimpahla zokugqoka zabesifazane abafika bengalungiselelwanga, kodwa uma uletha eyakho, ikakhulukazi eyodwa enemibala egqamile, uzothola ukumomotheka kommonki noma umlaleli emnyango.
Ngokufanayo, amadoda kudingeka agqoke amabhulukwe ahlanganisa amadolo.
Nalena ingabolekwa esitokisini esingeneni kodwa leyo mpahla ayihlanzwa ngemva komsebenzisi ngamunye ngakho-ke kungase kungabi lula ukugqoka lezi zingubo. Usayizi owodwa ufanelana namadoda!
Ukudla kwaseMoldorca, njengakwamanye amazwe afanayo aseMedithera, kusekelwe esibukweni, emifino nenyama (ikakhulukazi ingulube), futhi kusetshenziswa uwoyela womnqumo kuyo yonke indawo.
Isidlo sakusihlwa esilula esidumile, ikakhulukazi ehlobo, yi- Pa amb Oli: Isinkwa namafutha omnqumo, utamatisi, nanoma yiziphi izinongo ezitholakalayo njengoshizi, i-tunafish, njll.
Zonke izisimilo, eduze kwegama elithi Sie kuwe, zihlala ziqala ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu, ngisho nasenkabeni yomusho.
Le yindlela ebalulekile yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezenzo ezithile nezinto.
Kungase futhi kwenziwe lula ukufunda, nakuba ukubhala kuyinkimbinkimbi kancane ngenxa yesidingo sokuthola ukuthi isenzo noma isimilo sisetshenziswa ngendlela enesici.

Ngakho-ke, ukufunda lo mbhalo wokuqala wolimi kuzokusiza ufunde okuningi ngolimi lwesiPheresiya futhi uqonde imisho kangcono.

Njengoba ukungcola kokukhanya ngesikhathi sabo sokuphakama kwakungeyona inkinga enjengalezi namuhla, ngokuvamile kutholakala emadolobheni noma emakhaya, kulula ukufinyelela kuwo kunalawo akhiwe ezikhathini zanamuhla.

Ukubuka izimbali ze-cherry, okubizwa ngokuthi i-hanami, sekuyingxenye yamasiko aseJapane kusukela ngekhulu lesi-8.
Umqondo wavela eChina lapho izimbali ze-plum kwakuyimbali ekhethwayo.

Uma uvakashela ingadi elungiselelwe ngokomthetho, ukuqoqa "amasampuli" nakho kuzokwenza ukuba uphonswe ngaphandle, ngaphandle kwengxoxo.
ISingapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu futhi kulula kakhulu ukuhamba kuyo, futhi ungathenga cishe noma yini ngemva kokufika.

Izingubo ziyingubo ejwayelekile yebhizinisi, futhi osebenza nabo babizana ngamagama abo omndeni noma ngeziqu zomsebenzi.
